```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

## Exercise 3

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)

first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

print(wildfires)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    popup = paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", scales::comma(gis_acres)
    )
  )

largest_fire_geometries <- map(
  largest_fires$geometry_coordinates,
  \(rings) sf::st_polygon(
    map(rings, \(ring) do.call(rbind, map(ring, unlist)))
  )
)

largest_fires_sf <- sf::st_sf(
  largest_fires |> select(-geometry_coordinates),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(largest_fire_geometries, crs = 4326)
)

fire_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(largest_fires_sf)

leaflet(largest_fires_sf) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(popup = ~popup) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = fire_bounds[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = fire_bounds[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = fire_bounds[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = fire_bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```

## Search and rank fires

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres)
```

## Acres burned by state

```{r}
acres_by_state <- fires |>
  filter(!is.na(state)) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

top_states <- acres_by_state |>
  slice_max(total_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(state = fct_reorder(state, total_acres))

ggplot(top_states, aes(x = state, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Acres Burned",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Total reported fire acreage by state in wildfires.geojson."
  )
```
